MEET CARLOS

Every classroom has a Carlos.

Carlos is a kitty cat without any fur, and on his first day of school, he's bullied for it. Fortunately, he makes new friends who help him overcome the bullying and feel valued.

Young kids see themselves in Carlos and his friends, which makes it easier to talk about how it feels to be left out and what a good friend does.

THE LESSONS

Five lessons, ready to teach

Each one is led by a character from the book, from understanding what bullying is to making your whole classroom bully-free.
